title: Amount of the Returned-Payment Fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the class's returned-payment fee — the figure the class late-charge and payment terms set for the agreement's unit class — stated in US dollars and cents and rounded to the cent, half up.

## What the amount reads

| Input | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Unit class | the class on the rental agreement record |
| Class's returned-payment fee | the class payment terms for that unit class |

## Worked figure (hypothetical class with a $32.00 returned-payment fee)

A bank return of a payment on an agreement in that class carries a returned-payment fee of $32.00, posted against the returned payment.
